user_outcome: Agents and humans keep the existing calibrated, cost-useful any-step breach contract; Gnomon does not expose narrow cumulative-total intervals that missed 75% of realised totals.
retained_changes: serial resumable JointHorizonBench with atomic per-case checkpoints and exact immutable-surface hashes
corrected protocol provenance from generator 0.2 to the actual unchanged generator 0.3
reproducible rejected candidate in git history
rejected_changes: cumulative_horizon point, median, mean, and 80% total interval in the threshold event
human summary and compact agent exposure of the undercovered total interval
remaining_risks: The frozen real-series corpus produced no supported aligned-path rows, so current-head supported-path skill was not empirically re-established here.
Cumulative totals remain unavailable as a distribution until a separately frozen method achieves useful realised-total calibration.
The retained any-step estimator is useful for threshold decisions but is not evidence for aggregate-demand or budget-total questions.
